headline: Nureca Limited: Saurabh Goyal files SEBI Takeover Disclosure under Regulation 10(5)
sum: Saurabh Goyal has submitted a disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 10(5), indicating a change in substantial shareholding or acquisition triggering disclosure obligations to the NSE.
implication: Regulation 10(5) disclosure is a gating compliance step for any acquisition crossing 5% or other thresholds; the lack of deal value suggests this is a regulatory filing of a change in control or material shareholding rather than a third-party M&A transaction, and signals potential restructuring or insider consolidation.
detail: Nureca Limited, listed on NSE (ticker: NURECA), received a disclosure filing from Saurabh Goyal under the SEBI Takeover Code. Regulation 10(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 requires any acquirer crossing prescribed thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 75%, 90%) to make an open offer or file a disclosure. The filing was lodged with the NSE on 23 June 2026. The specific shareholding quantity, valuation, and underlying transaction structure are not disclosed in this regulatory filing notice.
